section: Multinational bank, London HQ move: AVI-SPL training and adoption programme and the reported impact (older platform)
body:
This part of the multinational bank case study covers how AVI-SPL prepared the bank's staff for the move into its new London headquarters, and what the bank's people said afterwards. Qualifier: this is an older-platform project, in which the standard meeting rooms used an HP Slice conferencing system on the Skype for Business Platform, so it is evidence of AVI-SPL's training and adoption method, not of a current platform deployment.

**The training and adoption programme**
- AVI-SPL's Training and Adoption team played a key role in moving the employees into the new headquarters.
- Emma Pieper, marketing manager, AVI-SPL UK, said workshops were held to make sure the adoption programme met the needs of all users.
- Proof-of-concept rooms in the existing headquarters were used to train a group of early adopters. These "change champions" were expected to pass their knowledge and experience on to colleagues.
- Pieper's team produced bite-size training videos carrying key messages to the whole workforce ahead of the changes and the move.
- Towards the end of the project the training team taught over 95 percent of the staff within a three-month period.
- Topics covered: booking, wayfinding, video conferencing, wireless sharing and first-line technical support.
- An AVI-SPL technical trainer stayed on site for the next three months to help staff settle in.
- The last element was on-demand support material: training videos and instructional user guides on a microsite built for the client, reached through QR codes printed on cards in the meeting spaces.

**Reported impact**
- Staff feedback on the training and adoption programme is described as overwhelmingly positive.
- Users felt comfortable and prepared to move. They found the training delivery and support material informative and easy to reach when and where needed.
- They also said the equipment and systems were intuitive and simple, which made the move less daunting and let them carry on their jobs with minimal disruption.
- The case study says the project met the client's overall goal of a completely flexible, hybrid workplace in which people work in whatever way and place is most effective for themselves, their team, their clients and the business. It credits evolving technology, innovative workspaces and new attitudes.
- AVI-SPL UK is said to have helped through these capabilities: wayfinding, find a person, space orientation, auto release, space booking and optimisation booking, occupancy, and space visualization maps.
- Michael Kellaway, Managing Director, AVI-SPL UK, called it an amazing project and said the company is extremely proud of what was achieved for the client.

**When to use this**
Use it when a customer asks how AVI-SPL handles user adoption for a large office move, what a training programme can include, or wants proof that training reached most of a workforce.

**Not stated in this source**: which products delivered the booking, occupancy and wayfinding functions, and any survey scores behind the feedback.
